I can do that, but archiving is an externally visible, destructive change (messages will be removed from your Inbox and moved to All Mail). Please confirm exactly what you want me to archive.

Options — reply with A, B, or C:
A) Archive every message in the "Launch approvals" thread (all 47 messages, including the final signed approval).
B) Archive all messages in that thread except the final signed approval (keep the signed approval in Inbox).
C) Cancel — do not archive anything.

If you choose A or B, I will proceed to archive immediately.
